messages:
sara: Hey team — heads up I'm changing my declared home base from CA -> Ireland effective 2026-04-15. I know we have a checklist but can someone confirm what happens to my WFH stipend, benefits enrollment, and payroll cutover?

jordan: Do you mean permanent move or a 3-6 month remote stint? That changes tax/benefits stuff.

sara: Permanent — relocating my tax/homebase to Dublin. Still on the same team and remote full-time.

raj: Thanks for the heads up, @sara. Two quick things: 1) From a tax nexus side we'll need to confirm no entity setup concerns (finance will check), 2) WFH stipend is pro-rated from the payroll cutover month unless you pick a new monthly envelope date.

maria: @sara please open the "Homebase Change" form (internal link: https://redwood.internal/hr/homebase-change) and upload your Irish tax ID and proof of address. Payroll needs that 10 business days before the first paycheck with the new homebase to avoid a gap.

payroll-bot: Automatic reminder: homebase-change form template v2 is attached in the form link. Missing documents will delay benefits transfer.

raj: On the WFH stipend topic — current policy: if your country change happens mid-pay-period we prorate by days in that country in the month. If you want to align to full-month payments we can change your stipend payment date, but that'll require a payroll schedule change request.

maria: Benefits note: you'll remain on Redwood US medical plan until the termination date we set with benefits team. For Ireland, we offer a local benefits package but there is a standard 30-day eligibility offset for non-ops moves. We'll need to run a benefits eligibility check once documents are in.

sara: OK — timeline check: I plan to move 2026-04-10 and update homebase effective 2026-04-15. If I submit docs by 2026-04-01 will that be enough?

maria: If docs in by 2026-04-01 we can target payroll cutover on 2026-04-15. Still depends on bank/payment validations for IE bank account and local tax ID verification.

raj: I'll run a quick tax nexus scan for IE and confirm by EOD tomorrow. If IE entity flags show up we'll need legal loop in.

jordan: One practical note — VPN/SSO geo restrictions: Eng infra will need the updated homebase so you don't hit MFA geo blocks. @sara please add a note in the infra-access form so we can update your geolocation whitelist before cutover.

maria: A couple of required fields we need in the HR form (paste for convenience):

```
// payroll/homebase-change payload
name: sara
current_country: USA
new_country: IRELAND
effective_date: 2026-04-15
local_tax_id: (uploaded document)
local_bank_details: (IBAN uploaded)
preferred_stipend_date: 15th or prorated
```

maria: If you want stipend aligned to full-months choose 1st or 15th depending on your payroll cadence. Otherwise we'll prorate April.

sara: Great — I'll submit docs today and pick 15th to keep the stipend consistent. Also tagging this so I can track any benefits blackout: @maria @raj @jordan.

payroll-bot: Acknowledged. Next steps: (1) sara submits form + docs, (2) finance does nexus scan, (3) payroll schedules cutover and verifies payment method, (4) benefits team processes enrollment change. Expect status updates in this thread. :thumbsup:

raj: Quick FYI to others — if multiple colleagues move to the same country within 30 days we'll batch the checks to avoid duplicate legal reviews.

jordan: Noted. Let us know if you need help with the infra form — I'll slot time tomorrow to make sure SSO exceptions are applied prior to your first login from IE.

sara: Thanks everyone — filing now. I'll post the submitted confirmation here when done. :)
